legend: Image by Joost J. Bakker, from commons.wikimedia.org
You have just started at the Nordic Cargo Permuting Company, whose business is moving cargo between its $$$k$$$ cargo bays.

Your boss has handed you today's work order: a list of $$$n$$$ cargo swaps. Each swap names two bays, and carrying it out means exchanging the cargo in those two bays. The swaps are to be carried out in the order listed. Your boss is adamant that every swap is carried out as written, for various paperwork reasons.
You wonder whether the work order could be shortened. A section of the list consists of the swaps at list positions $$$\ell$$$ through $$$r$$$, for some $$$1 \leq \ell \leq r \leq n$$$.

A section is redundant if skipping it makes no difference: carrying out only the swaps outside the section, in the order listed, leaves every piece of cargo in the same bay as carrying out the entire list does.
You are sure your cutting and gluing skills are up to the task of removing a redundant section from the work order. But how many sections are redundant?
input: One line with two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 10^6$$$, $$$2 \leq k \leq 10^6$$$), the number of cargo swaps and the number of cargo bays.

$$$n$$$ lines, each containing two integers $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$ ($$$1 \leq a, b \leq k$$$, $$$a \neq b$$$), a request to swap the cargo in bays $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$. The swaps are given in the order listed in the work order.
output: Output the number of redundant sections.

你刚刚加入了北欧货物置换公司，该公司的业务是在其 $$$k$$$ 个货舱之间运输货物。
你的老板交给你今天的工作单：一份包含 $$$n$$$ 次货物交换的列表。每次交换都会指定两个货舱，执行该交换意味着互换这两个货舱中的货物。交换必须按照列表中的顺序进行。由于各种文书方面的原因，你的老板坚持要求每次交换都必须严格按照记录执行。
你想知道是否可以缩短操作序列。列表中的一段由位置 $$$\ell$$$ 到 $$$r$$$ 的交换组成，其中 $$$1 \leq \ell \leq r \leq n$$$ 为某个值。
如果跳过某一段后结果没有任何变化，则称该段是冗余的：仅按所列顺序执行该段之外的交换操作后，每件货物所在的泊位都与执行完整操作列表后的结果相同。
你确信自己的剪切和粘贴技巧足以完成从工作单中移除冗余部分的任务。但究竟有多少部分是冗余的？

input.ai: 一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$k$$$($$$1 \leq n \leq 10^6$$$、$$$2 \leq k \leq 10^6$$$)，分别表示货物交换次数和货舱数量。
$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $$$a$$$ 和 $$$b$$$($$$1 \leq a, b \leq k$$$、$$$a \neq b$$$)，表示交换货舱 $$$a$$$ 和 $$$b$$$ 中货物的请求。交换请求按照工作单中列出的顺序给出。
